grammar: I'll take this one.
en: I'll take this one.
ipa: /aɪl teɪk ðɪs wʌn/
trPron: Ayl teyk dis van
commonMistake: I'll take that one. ❌ (uzak)

grammar: Are you going to order this or that?
en: Are you going to order this or that?
tr: Bunu mu yoksa şunu mu sipariş edeceksiniz?
ipa: /ɑr juː ˈgoʊɪŋ tu ˈɔrdər ðɪs ɔr ðæt/
trPron: Ar yu goİng tu ordır dis or det
collocations: order this or, this or that
commonMistake: Are you going to order this or this? ❌
aiExplain: Menüde yakın ve uzak seçenekler için "this" ve "that".

grammar: This is my room key.
en: This is my room key.
ipa: /ðɪs ɪz maɪ rum ki/
trPron: Dis iz may rum ki
collocations: this is my, is my room
commonMistake: That is my room key. ❌

grammar: These are our new targets for this quarter.
en: These are our new targets for this quarter.
tr: Bunlar bu çeyrek için yeni hedeflerimiz.
ipa: /ðiz ɑr ˈaʊər nuː ˈtɑrgəts fɔr ðɪs ˈkwɔrtər/
trPron: Diz ar auır nu target for dis vortır
commonMistake: This is our new targets. ❌

grammar: I like these, but I don't like those.
en: I like these, but I don't like those.
ipa: /aɪ laɪk ðiz bʌt aɪ doʊnt laɪk ðoʊz/
trPron: Ay layk diz bat ay dont layk doz
commonMistake: I like these but I don't like these. ❌
imgQuery: two pairs of shoes different distances

grammar: This is my address. Do you have a pen?
en: This is my address. Do you have a pen?
tr: Bu benim adresim. Kalemin var mı?
ipa: /ðɪs ɪz maɪ ˈædrɛs du juː hæv ə pɛn/
trPron: Dis iz may adres du yu hev ı pen
collocations: this is my, is my address
commonMistake: That is my address. ✔️ (telefonda doğru)

grammar: This looks good. What are you having?
en: This looks good. What are you having?
tr: Bu güzel görünüyor. Sen ne alıyorsun?
ipa: /ðɪs lʊks gʊd wʌt ɑr juː ˈhævɪŋ/
trPron: Dis luks gud vat ar yu havİng
commonMistake: That looks good. ❌ (fiziksel yakın)

grammar: Is this your pen or mine?
en: Is this your pen or mine?
tr: Bu senin kalemin mi benimki mi?
ipa: /ɪz ðɪs jʊr pɛn ɔr maɪn/
trPron: İz dis yur pen or mayn
commonMistake: Is that your pen or mine? ❌ (uzak)

grammar: Is this your bag, sir?
en: Is this your bag, sir?
ipa: /ɪz ðɪs jʊr bæg sɜr/
trPron: İz dis yur bag sör
commonMistake: Is that your bag, sir? ❌ (fiziksel yakın)

grammar: Look at this photo I took yesterday.
en: Look at this photo I took yesterday.
ipa: /lʊk æt ðɪs ˈfoʊtoʊ aɪ tʊk ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
trPron: Luk et dis foto ay tuk yestırdey
commonMistake: Look at that photo I took yesterday. ❌

grammar: Those toys on the floor need to be picked up.
en: Those toys on the floor need to be picked up.
ipa: /ðoʊz tɔɪz ɑn ðə flɔr nid tu bi pɪkt ʌp/
trPron: Doz toys on dı flor nid tu bi pikt ap
commonMistake: These toys on the floor need to be picked up. ❌ (yakın değil)

grammar: What is this dish called?
en: What is this dish called?
ipa: /wʌt ɪz ðɪs dɪʃ kɔld/
trPron: Vat iz dis diş kold
commonMistake: What is that dish called? ❌
aiExplain: Menüde işaret ettiğiniz yemek için "this dish".

grammar: That building over there is the museum.
en: That building over there is the museum.
ipa: /ðæt ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈoʊvər ðɛr ɪz ðə mjuˈziəm/
trPron: Det bildİng ovır der iz dı myuziım
commonMistake: This building over there is the museum. ❌
aiExplain: Uzaktaki bina için "That building over there".

grammar: These fit perfectly, but those are too tight.
en: These fit perfectly, but those are too tight.
tr: Bunlar mükemmel uydu, ama şunlar çok dar.
ipa: /ðiz fɪt ˈpɜrfɪktli bʌt ðoʊz ɑr tu taɪt/
trPron: Diz fit pörfiktli bat doz ar tu tayt
commonMistake: These fit perfectly, but these are too tight. ❌

grammar: These points are important. Please remember them.
en: These points are important. Please remember them.
tr: Bu maddeler önemli. Lütfen onları hatırlayın.
ipa: /ðiz pɔɪnts ɑr ɪmˈpɔrtənt pliz rɪˈmɛmbər ðɛm/
trPron: Diz poynts ar importınt pliz rimembır dem
commonMistake: This point is important. ❌ (sayı uyumsuz)

grammar: I can't believe this mess! It was clean yesterday.
en: I can't believe this mess! It was clean yesterday.
ipa: /aɪ kænt bɪˈliv ðɪs mɛs ɪt wʌz klin ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
trPron: Ay kant biliv dis mes it vaz klin yestırdey
commonMistake: I can't believe that mess! ❌ (fiziksel yakın)

grammar: Excuse me, is this the right bus for the city center?
en: Excuse me, is this the right bus for the city center?
tr: Affedersiniz, bu şehir merkezi için doğru otobüs mü?
ipa: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɪz ðɪs ðə raɪt bʌs fɔr ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər/
trPron: İkskyuz mi iz dis dı rayt bas for dı sİti sentır
collocations: is this the, this the right
commonMistake: Excuse me, is that the right bus? ❌

grammar: Are you finished with these plates?
en: Are you finished with these plates?
ipa: /ɑr juː ˈfɪnɪʃt wɪð ðiz pleɪts/
trPron: Ar yu fİnİşt vit diz pleyts
commonMistake: Are you finished with this plates? ❌

grammar: This party is amazing! I'm having a great time.
en: This party is amazing! I'm having a great time.
tr: Bu parti harika! Harika vakit geçiriyorum.
ipa: /ðɪs ˈpɑrti ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ aɪm ˈhævɪŋ ə greɪt taɪm/
trPron: Dis parti iz ımeyzİng aym havİng ı greyt taym
commonMistake: That party is amazing! ❌ (fiziksel yakın)

grammar: That's everything. How much is it?
en: That's everything. How much is it?
ipa: /ðæts ˈɛvriθɪŋ haʊ mʌʧ ɪz ɪt/
trPron: Dets evriİng hav maç iz it
commonMistake: This is everything. ❌ (anlam farklı)

grammar: This is she. / This is he. (telefonda)
en: Hello? Yes, this is she. How can I help you?
tr: Alo? Evet, benim. Size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
ipa: /hɛˈloʊ jɛs ðɪs ɪz ʃi haʊ kæn aɪ hɛlp ju/
trPron: Helo yes dis iz şi hav ken ay help yu
commonMistake: Yes, I am she. ❌ (doğru dilbilgisi ama doğal değil)

grammar: Have you seen these keys? I can't find them.
en: Have you seen these keys? I can't find them.
tr: Bu anahtarları gördün mü? Onları bulamıyorum.
ipa: /hæv juː sin ðiz kiz aɪ kænt faɪnd ðɛm/
trPron: Hev yu sin diz kiz ay kant faynd dem
commonMistake: Have you seen this keys? ❌

grammar: Who is that person over there?
en: Who is that person over there?
ipa: /hu ɪz ðæt ˈpɜrsən ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
trPron: Hu iz det pörsın ovır der
commonMistake: Who is this person over there? ❌
aiExplain: Uzaktaki kişi için "that person over there".

scenario: Customer asking for a different size
grammar: Do you have these in a smaller size?
en: Do you have these in a smaller size?
tr: Bunları daha küçük bedende var mı?
ipa: /duː juː hæv ðiz ɪn ə ˈsmɔlər saɪz/
trPron: Du yu hev diz in ı smolır sayz
collocations: have these in, these in a
commonMistake: Do you have this in a smaller size? ❌ (tekil)
aiExplain: Birden fazla ürün için "Do you have these".

grammar: This is where we are now. (pointing at map)
en: This is where we are now. (pointing at map)
ipa: /ðɪs ɪz wɛr wi ɑr naʊ/
trPron: Dis iz ver vi ar nau
collocations: this is where, where we are
commonMistake: That is where we are now. ❌ (işaret ederken)
aiExplain: Harita üzerinde işaret ederken "This is where".
